maddeler.e:
أبتعد (form VIII)
# أَبْتَعِدُ (ʔabtaʕidu) /ʔab.ta.ʕi.du/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِبْتَعَدَ (ibtaʕada)
# أَبْتَعِدَ (ʔabtaʕida) /ʔab.ta.ʕi.da/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِبْتَعَدَ (ibtaʕada)
# أَبْتَعِدْ (ʔabtaʕid) /ʔab.ta.ʕid/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِبْتَعَدَ (ibtaʕada)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
